segments.contextAfter: `item`: A binding to an optional source of truth for the popover. When `item` is non-`nil`, the system passes the contents to the modifier’s closure. You use this content to populate the fields of a popover that you create that the system displays to the user. If `item` changes, the system dismisses the currently presented popover and replaces it with a new popover using the same process.
